items.name: Carbonara Docker
items.description: Handmade spaghetti wrapped in egg-yolk cream, Pecorino Romano and crispy guanciale, served inside a crunchy, isolated Parmesan basket.
items.package: A production-ready Dockerfile (multi-stage, non-root user) for a Node.js app.
items.template:
# Dockerfile: multi-stage build for a Node.js app
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev

FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

items.name: Risotto di GitHub
items.description: Creamy Italian saffron risotto with squid and shrimp, finished with a grilled lobster tail standing upright like a fork.
items.package: A GitHub Actions CI workflow: install, lint and test on every push and pull request.
items.template:
# .github/workflows/ci.yml
name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint --if-present
      - run: npm test

items.name: Gnocchi Kubernetes
items.description: Handmade purple-potato gnocchi floating in harmony in a warm cluster of sweet Gorgonzola fondue.
items.package: A Kubernetes Deployment + Service with 3 replicas, probes and resource limits.
items.template:
# deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: multiverse-app
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: multiverse-app }
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: { app: multiverse-app }
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: ghcr.io/you/multiverse-app:latest
          ports: [{ containerPort: 3000 }]
          readinessProbe: { httpGet: { path: /health, port: 3000 } }
          resources:
            limits: { cpu: 500m, memory: 256Mi }
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: multiverse-app }
spec:
  selector: { app: multiverse-app }
  ports: [{ port: 80, targetPort: 3000 }]

[alias]
  st = status -sb
  co = checkout
  lg = log --oneline --graph --decorate -20
  amend = commit --amend --no-edit
  pushf = push --force-with-lease
  undo = reset --soft HEAD~1

# Safe push routine

items.name: Python Negroni
items.description: Gin infused with exotic botanicals, Vermouth Rosso, Campari and an orange peel hand-twisted into the shape of a snake inside the glass.
items.package: A clean Python script template with argparse and logging. Bonus: you jump higher for 30s.
items.template:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Small CLI tool template."""
import argparse
import logging

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format='%(levelname)s %(message)s')

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Python Negroni CLI')
    parser.add_argument('name', help='who to greet')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    logging.info('Hello, %s!', args.name)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
